title: Energizing Shaggy French Dish Bake
description: A fermented and energizing French dish featuring green salsa, bonito-shave, and a fodmap-friendly ingredient list.

ingredients.name: Fodmap-friendly sausage
ingredients.notes: Look for a sausage with minimal ingredients

ingredients.name: Bonito flakes
ingredients.notes: Shave using a grater or sharp knife

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the rye sourdough starter, green salsa, butternut squash puree, celeriac root, and sausage. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Sprinkle the bonito flakes and parsley over the top of the mixture.
Drizzle the coconut oil over the top of the mixture and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Bake for 40 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the mixture is hot and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and brush with lemon juice.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 5 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
To reheat, bake in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 15-20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Serve with additional green salsa on the side, if desired.
